session/search.about: Search what every session's log holds, running or done: with query alone, the sessions whose records match, best first, each with its best record; with query and session, that session's matching records; with session and around, the records near one, whole.

query.description: words a record holds, each whole; OR, "a phrase" and word* as FTS5 reads them

session.description: a session's id or the start of it

around.description: a record's seq in that session

count.description: how many sessions, or records, at most (10); with no query, how many on each side (5)

sessions.description: the matching sessions, best first: a session's fields, record_count and its best record

records.description: records: seq, kind (user, notice, reply, call, handoff), a call's tool or a notice's source, sender, action, target, time and a snippet (a match marked « ») or, near around, the whole text

matched_by.description: what the records hold: every word, or, when no record does, any of them
